17 is below 18, so the trigger `temperature < 18` holds: the transition fires, `heating` becomes true and the chart is in `Heating`.
19 degrees. `Heating` waits for `temperature >= 21`, which is false, so the heater stays on. `Idle`'s trigger is not checked at all: only the active state's transitions count.
21 is at least 21: the heater goes off and the chart is back in `Idle`.
19 degrees again, as in tick 3, but now the chart is in `Idle`, and 19 is not below 18. Same input, different reaction: the state remembers which way the temperature was going.
